metadata.title: Samsung Display, LG Display to start OLED production for Apple's 2027 iPhones

content.text:
LG Display plans to begin mass production of OLED panels for Apple's standard iPhone 18 by the end of 2026, with Samsung Display following in January 2027, as Apple's new launch schedule changes production plans for its Korean suppliers.
The article requires paid subscription.
